about_the_game:
【Worldview Background | The Rise of Mortals in a World of Gods and Demons】

Summary: Based on Eastern mythology, it creates an epic journey of a mortal's rise to divinity.

In this chaotic world where spiritual energy is depleted and gods and demons vie for power, players will start from a humble mortal village, pass through the trial of the "Demon-Slaying Platform", and gradually unlock the ancient bloodline power. The plot spans the conflicts among the three realms, revealing the ancient secrets hidden by the "Heavenly Mechanism Pavilion", and fighting alongside classic divine generals like Nezha and Yang Jian to rewrite the fate dominated by the Heavenly Dao.

【Core Combat System | Strategic Combinations Ignite the Stage】

Summary: The dual thrill of real-time cooperation and strategic positioning.

The battle adopts the "Spirit Vein Resonance" system. Five elemental divine generals can trigger attribute affinities. For instance, consecutive attacks by the fire-elemental divine general will trigger the "Burning Heaven" area-of-effect burn. The unique "Breakthrough · Awakening" mechanism allows players to manually release the second form of the divine general when the team's health drops below 20%. Sun Wukong will transform into the "Qitian Douzhan Buddha" and sweep across the entire screen. Coupled with screen-shaking effects and dynamic camera movements, it brings a cinematic battle performance.

【Character Cultivation System | Freely Shape Your Exclusive Divine General】

Summary: A deep cultivation ecosystem that breaks through the traditional numerical framework

Each deity general will have three cultivation lines: "Fated Artifact", "Trial of Inner Demons", and "Reincarnation and Reformation". Players can equip Lu Bu with "Fang Tian Hua Ji · God Slayer" to change his skill form, or choose through the "Slaying Inner Demons" plot to have Zhuge Liang retrain as an explosive strategist with "Burning the Linked Camps", or a control-type military advisor with "Eight Trigram Formation". All cultivation choices will affect the character's appearance and plot branches.

【Art and Music | A New Realm of Dynamic Xianxia Aesthetics】

Summary: Pioneered the "Ink Particle" rendering technology

The character costumes are made of dynamic ink-wash material. When Zhao Yun wields his spear, the sleeves of his clothes will splash real-time calculated ink stains. In terms of scene design, the peach blossom forest will present two ecological modes, "falling petals in profusion" and "night dance of fairy butterflies", according to the alternation of day and night. The original music team of "JX3" was specially invited to create interactive environmental sound effects - when attacking River God, the ancient zither scale will vary with the rhythm of the skills.

【Continuous Update Plan | Building the Mythical Universe Together】

Summary: A living ecosystem where players determine the direction of world evolution.

The quarterly expansion pack will open up new otherworldly realms such as "Four Seas Dragon Palace" and "Eighteen Levels of Hell", and the plot direction will be determined by a vote of all players in the server - whether to assist Niu Mo Wang in overthrowing the Heavenly Court or to assist Meng Po in reconstructing the cycle of reincarnation system. The first-year plan includes 12 mythological characters that can be cultivated, 7 sets of freely combinable formation systems, and a "Zhu Xian Sword Array" siege battle that supports up to a thousand players on the same screen.

Join "The Chronicles of Mortals and Divine Generals" right now and rewrite your own mythological annals with your own hands.
